modules.module_title: Select the site and plan the construction activities

pcs.pc_description: select an appropriate site with adequate and appropriate vegetation, i.e. feed ingredients, to feed pigs
ensure the site is at an appropriate distance from dwellings, factories, dairies, poultry farms, food grains storage, etc. following the BIS standards
check the site has an adequate and reliable water supply
check that the site does not experience extended exposure to sunlight, waterlogging and has proximity to the relevant markets for procuring the relevant inputs and marketing pigs
plan the construction activities at the pig farm, including an appropriate number of pens to facilitate breeding and fattening activities
ensure compliance with local regulations and animal welfare laws
estimate the budget and labour requirement for construction and other farm activities

modules.module_title: Coordinate the pig farm construction activities

pcs.pc_description: arrange the required tools, equipment and material, e.g. wood, bamboo sticks, concrete, stone slabs, bricks, etc., for the construction activities
assist in the installation of durable and strong fences around the pig farm for restricting animal movements and implement biosecurity
coordinate with the relevant expert for the construction of pigsty following BIS standards
ensure concrete and sloping floor of the recommended thickness in the pigsty, and smooth walls for the easy removal of animal waste and thorough cleaning
install appropriate bedding in the individual pens for the animal comfort, especially during winters
ensure adequate space and ventilation for easy maintenance and healthy growth of pigs, considering the number of pigs planned at the farm
ensure the construction of drainage channels to drain out animal waste from the farm
set up feeders and water troughs at appropriate locations to ensure their easy accessibility to the pigs and cleaners/attendants
ensure appropriate arrangements at the farm to protect pigs from adverse weather, i.e. roofing and shading of weather-proof material

modules.module_title: Perform nutrient and health management of fatteners

pcs.pc_description: ensure hygienic and safe fattening pens for the procured fatteners with appropriate bedding for them
maintain the appropriate temperature in the fattening pens and arrange hog wallows as appropriate
prepare and feed the fatteners with the appropriate feed containing the necessary nutrients for their healthy growth and fattening
monitor the fatteners during feeding to ensure their optimum feeding and follow the appropriate measures to minimize the wastage of feed
conduct regular inspections of the fatteners and identify the signs of diseases, disorders, parasitic infections, and injuries
treat the fatteners by providing them appropriate treatment or coordinate with a veterinarian for their treatment
maintain cleanliness in the fattening pens, removing the animal and other waste regularly
monitor the fatteners and prevent them from scavenging
check the growth of fatteners and determine if they are mature for marketing
